map.有效蜡量 = 重量 × 0.85（约 15% 为残留不可燃）；烛芯系数：1 根=: Effective wax = weight × 0.85 (about 15% is unburnable residue); wick coefficients: 1 wick = 1, 2 wicks ≈ 1.7, 3 wicks ≈ 2.3 (multiple wicks accelerate non-linearly); combined burn rate = base wax rate × wick coefficient × temperature coefficient; burn hours = effective wax ÷ combined rate; usable days = burn hours ÷ 4. Base rates (g/h): beeswax 6, soy wax 7, coconut wax 7.5, blended wax 8, palm wax 8.5, paraffin 9.
map.200 g 大豆蜡单芯、温度系数 1.0：有效蜡量 = 200×0.85 = 1: A 200 g soy candle with one wick and temperature coefficient 1.0: effective wax = 200×0.85 = 170 g; burn rate = 7×1×1 = 7 g/h; burn time = 170/7 ≈ 24.3 hours; at 4 hours a day that is about 6 days. Switching to two wicks gives rate = 7×1.7 = 11.9 g/h and the duration drops to about 14.3 hours.
map.为什么只算 85% 的蜡？: Why is only 85% of the wax counted?
map.容器壁残留、烛芯无法吸到的部分与底部余蜡通常不可燃，按 15% 扣减是行业常用的: Residue on the container wall, wax the wick cannot reach and the pool at the bottom are usually unburnable, and deducting 15% is a common industry rule of thumb; in reality the container shape also matters.
map.大直径蜡烛有什么问题？: What is the problem with very wide candles?
map.直径过大时火焰热量不足以熔化到边缘，会形成“隧道效应”浪费蜡材；一般直径超过 1: When the diameter is too large the flame cannot melt wax out to the edge, creating a tunnel effect that wastes wax; in general, for diameters over 100 mm use multiple wicks and burn long enough each time to level the surface.
